summary: News sweep of the Federal Register issues of 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13 (no issue on the 2026-11-11 holiday; read on federalregister.gov and the GovInfo PDFs it links), the White House presidential actions page (a Veterans Day proclamation, a presidential determination on wildfire suppression and nominations, none bearing on a tracked recommendation), the Supreme Court orders page (a 2026-11-12 order in a capital case only; No. 26-239 was conferenced 2026-11-13 with no order yet) and watch-item searches. Mapped developments: the HUD final rule on verification of eligible status of 2026-11-12 (91 FR 72978, FR Doc. 2026-23003, effective 2026-12-14; c15-02) and the FCC final rule of 2026-11-12 repealing the national television multiple ownership cap (91 FR 72799, FR Doc. 2026-23040, effective 2027-01-11; c28-06). The IRS scholarship tax credit hearing notice (FR Doc. 2026-23032), the Forest Service rangeland management proposed rule, the reopened Arctic OCS drilling comment period and the MSHA rules of 2026-11-12 do not bear on a tracked recommendation and were not added. Rotation: 15 freshness checks (c11-31, c06-19, c17-09, c14-23, c04-28, c18-18, c04-05, c04-07, c21-02, c14-17, c05-31, c14-49, c17-18, c17-13, c17-14; three gained evidence, twelve unchanged) and 10 refutation checks (c08-05, c01-06, c04-15, c02-11, c06-11, c11-17, c14-04, c20-01, c14-13, c17-02; all hold, two with the verdict weakened because no later confirming document was found). One stage changed: c15-02 moved from proposed 20 to in_progress 45 because the HUD verification rule is final but not yet effective. c17-09 gained the Eastern District of New York Memorandum and Order of 2026-10-15 dismissing the federal suit against New York City's sanctuary laws (court status stays dismissed, now dated 2026-10-15). Every record whose content changed was independently reviewed with the chapter text checked. Counted set 627: proposed 159, in progress 210.
